title: dedicated-autoscaler-burst-util-reporting-enhancement
author: Samira Khan
description: Motivation: current dedicated autoscaler reporting undercounts short burst windows and does not expose per-fleet token-bucket utilization, making capacity planning and incident triage difficult. This PR adds finer-grained burst utilization metrics, surfaces token-bucket saturation events, and improves reporting aggregation for per-fleet dashboards.  Summary of changes: 1) Add new metrics: dedicated_fleet:tokenbucket_utilization, dedicated_fleet:burst_saturation_events, and dedicated_fleet:burst_window_p95; 2) Emit token-bucket fill/empty events from the allocator; 3) Update the autoscaler reporter to aggregate by fleet_id and priority class for 10s/1m/5m windows; 4) Add unit and integration tests for metric correctness and backward-compatible metric names; 5) Update docs and dashboard jsonnet for the per-fleet view.  Checklist: - [x] Add metrics and instrumentation - [x] Update reporter aggregation - [x] Add tests (unit + integration) - [x] Update dashboards and docs - [x] Add migration note for alert rules  Context/Notes: This targets the dedicated autoscaler and reporter only; no changes to routing or admitting logic. Metric names are additive and backward compatible. The metrics are low-cardinality and include tags: fleet_id, priority, region. Related: ENG-4219 (better burst observability), SUP-9742 (customer reported undercounting).
commits: Add tokenbucket utilization metric and event emitter
Aggregate burst metrics by fleet and priority
Add integration tests for burst metrics
review_comments: Priya Natarajan: Can you confirm the cardinality of the new tags? We should avoid freeform tags here.
Samira Khan: Confirmed - tags are fleet_id (low-cardinality UUID), priority (enum), region (enum). Added a note in metrics_registry.go to enforce allowed values.
Ethan Cole: Integration test flakes on CI - looks like timing sensitivity in the 10s window aggregation. Can we make the test tolerant to +/-1s?
Samira Khan: Adjusted test timing and added retries; re-ran CI.
Maya Chen: Docs look good. One nit: include a migration snippet for existing alerts that reference old metric 'autoscaler.burst_util'
Samira Khan: Added migration snippet to automation/alerts and called out the deprecation timeline in docs.
Priya Natarajan: Approve after addressing the flake and confirming metrics cardinality.
release_notes: Add per-fleet token-bucket utilization metrics and burst saturation events for dedicated autoscaler. Backward-compatible metric additions; update alert rules to use dedicated_fleet:burst_saturation_events. See docs/observability/dedicated-autoscaler.md for dashboard and migration notes.
